name: @pipeworx/mcp-pipeworx-faq

tools.name: about_pipeworx
tools.description: Answers questions about Pipeworx itself — what it is, pricing and the free tier, rate limits, how routing and grounding work, reliability and uptime, privacy, comparisons, how to submit an API, and how to get support. Use this for meta questions about the Pipeworx platform or gateway. Example: about_pipeworx({ question: "what does Pipeworx cost?" })

question.description: The question about Pipeworx, e.g. "is it free?", "how does routing work?", "what data do you have?"

tools.name: pipeworx_story
tools.description: What Pipeworx is building and why: the vision, roadmap direction, where the catalog is deepest, a free keyless call that works right now, and where the project stands. Each section is labelled live, building or direction and dated, with its public source. Omit question for the whole story. Answers questions like "what is Pipeworx building toward?", "where is this going?", "why should I use Pipeworx?". Example: pipeworx_story({ question: "what is pipeworx building?" })

question.description: Optional question about Pipeworx's direction or purpose, e.g. "what is pipeworx building toward?". Omit for the whole story.

audience.description: Optional hint that reorders sections: agent, developer, investor, partner or press. Never changes the copy.

tools.name: pipeworx_getting_started
tools.description: Step-by-step instructions for connecting an AI client to Pipeworx — Claude Code, claude.ai, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, Perplexity, ChatGPT, or any MCP-capable client. Returns the gateway URL, plugin links, and first-question suggestions. Example: pipeworx_getting_started({ client: "cursor" })

client.description: Optional client name, e.g. "claude code", "cursor", "windsurf", "gemini", "perplexity", "chatgpt". Omit for generic MCP instructions.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-pipeworx-faq forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the pipeworx-faq pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
